verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is published under an open license is a fair question for any software product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Claude Design's own source code is available or openly licensed. The mentions of exportable HTML/CSS/JS concern user-generated design output, not the product's source, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
